British YouTuber

**Simon Minter** (born 7 September 1992), better known as **Miniminter** is an English YouTuber, streamer and Internet personality. He is a member and co-founder of the Sidemen[1], a British YouTube group. He has 4 channels on YouTube, and has attracted a big audience with 17.502 million subscribers combined across all four as of September 2023.

## Early life

[edit]

Minter was educated at Berkhamsted School, where he met future Sidemen member and collaborator KSI.[3]



## Career

[edit]

Minter is a YouTuber and is part of British YouTube group, the Sidemen[1]. His main YouTube channel, *Miniminter*, was created in February 2008[4] and has amassed over 3.6 billion views. Aside from his main channel, he has 3 separate channels with a combined view count of over 3.7 billion views.


Minter has also created a podcast with Randolph, another British YouTuber, titled the *What’s Good Podcast*. It was created on November 1st, 2018; having since amassed over 260 million views, and 960k subscribers.



## Personal life

[edit]

Minter is married to British singer Talia Mar. The pair had been dating since mid 2017, and moved in together in February 2023. They announced their engagement via Instagram and got married on 3 June, 2023. They now have a dog called Mooshoo.


Minter loves to play Football, having focused many videos on the sport, as well as playing in the Sidemen Charity Match 7 times - being a member of the Sidemen’s team. He was the first ever person to hit 10 out of 10 rating on Fotomob. 


  




## References
